name: my girl grows
source:
The visual novel tells the story of Marco and Luisa. How big will Luisa's muscles get? How much will they grow?

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240106143136/https://rattapumba.itch.io/my-girl-grows]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说讲述了马可和路易莎的故事。路易莎的肌肉会长到多大？他们会成长多少？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240106143136/https://rattapumba.itch.io/my-girl-grows]itch.io[/url]]
